data.title: Northern Virginia Inventory Rises Again as Home Sales Decline and Prices Increase
data.description: In the Fairfax, Virginia area, the number of active listings has increased by 30.7% compared to last year. This rise is predominantly fueled by a growing inventory of condos and townhomes. Additionally, the median sold price has gone up by 4.2%. This trend signifies a significant development in Northern Virginia's housing market.
